skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Gate 3 — Profile the entity, then interview the user': 'never default a useful life, a salvage value, a capitalization threshold, or a convention', yet 'Step 5 — Compute depreciation for the period' cannot run without all of them; no rule says what to do when the uploaded register omits method, salvage and convention, so every manual run must invent an assumption set.

SKILL.md 'Step 9 — Roll-forward and tie-out' needs opening cost and accumulated depreciation and an asset-level accumulated-depreciation figure, but 'Step 12 — Output' Sheet 1 'Asset Register Master' has no accumulated-depreciation column and the manual checklist never asks for the prior register or opening TB, so the register-to-GL tie of accumulated depreciation is structurally impossible on upload.

SKILL.md 'Step 2b — Test the threshold against the expense accounts' is called 'the highest-value check in the skill' but on upload it needs an expense-side GL; 'Ask the user to upload the data' does not name it, and a bank-side-only extract silently defeats it.
SKILL.md 'Step 8 — Disposals' assumes a gain/loss-on-disposal account exists; no instruction for a chart with none, or for a disposal in a prior month whose GL was not uploaded.
SKILL.md is a single 1,169-line file in which the manual-run rules sit inside the shared Mosofin scope block; 'Step 12' Sheet 11 coverage columns are Mosofin-only.
